name: NO NAME CITY LUXURY CABIN & RV ~

violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — ---Bar staff using yellow cleaner and cloth to wipe down syrup bottles. -Bar staff stated ammonia window cleaner used to wipe down bar top (epoxy). -Windex and cloth used to wipe out microwave. *Redirected immediately, directed to use sani bucket for wet cloth wipe down.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Cooked ground meat not date marked.--Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. -Tartar sauce and pickles were date marked Jun 9th. (Stated as old labels but new product.)

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Black/pink debris at bottom edge of interior panel of ice machine.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Some debris/splatter at interior of kitchen microwave. (COS) -Some residue at oven handles and refrigerator handle. -Spill/debris in bottom of keg cooler.

Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Three compartment sink was not maintained or operated in the approved three step method. -Sani sink stated as set up for wiping cloth during service. *Ensure cloth is not used in sani sink solution used for dishes. Also, ensure ALL dishes are washed, rinsed, sanitized and air dried.

Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. -Facility does not have Quat test strips available for quat solutions.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. -Apparent leak at bottom of drain line of 3 comp sink. -Drain line in keg cooler ran to and missed bucket used inside unit.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc. …) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Debris (and water from leak) build up below 3 comp sink.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc. …) were not maintained in good repair. -Worn/damaged concrete floor at back room area of kitchen.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.
